nodes.label: Admin — Kelola User
nodes.rationale: User management page restricted to admin/super_admin; users are soft-deleted (kept in DB, hidden from list); password not editable — reset requires delete+recreate or a dedicated endpoint.

nodes.label: Role Hierarchy (super_admin/admin/member)
nodes.rationale: Only super_admin can CRUD users and is never selectable from UI (set via API/seeder); admin is read-only for users; member manages only own apps.

nodes.label: User Management API Endpoints
nodes.rationale: CRUD endpoints under /api/users require JWT Bearer token with super_admin (write) or admin (read) role.
